ktk.text: Tarkir begins when Ugin arrives on a half-born plane after his rebirth and forms its landscape, creatures and peoples, his wing beats birthing the dragonstorms.

In the original timeline Nicol Bolas kills Ugin, which ends the elemental storms and lets the clans hunt Tarkir's dragons to extinction, and the clans then wage a thousand-year conflict for supremacy over the plane.
In that world the Sultai fall from grace through the actions of their human khan, and Kolaghan smashes into the cliff at Wingthrone, her skull becoming the Mardu khan's throne.
Another history branches off when Sarkhan Vol saves Ugin in 3279 AR, and in that current timeline the dragonlords eventually take over the clans, with Narset leading a reformed Jeskai clan.

frf.text: Tarkir's fate is sealed when Ugin's whispered summons leads Sarkhan Vol to the primal battle between Ugin and Nicol Bolas, which Sarkhan watches from the sky above the plane.
Sarkhan travels 1,280 years back in time and sees dragons emerge from a storm, realizing the gate has carried him to Tarkir's past as Narset's scrolls foretold.

He learns that Yasova's voice is Bolas, who has come to kill Ugin, but Bolas fights Ugin, Yasova's spell grips Sarkhan, and Ugin is mortally wounded. Sarkhan then activates the hedron around the dying dragon, preserving him and rewriting history.
Sarkhan embraces the change and calls this new beginning his Tarkir, while the Khanfall lets dragon tempests grow and five dragonlords rise to dominate the humanoid races.

dtk.text: On Tarkir, Bolas appears in Ugin's path, and Yasova's elemental spell turns dozens of dragons against Ugin, so that the Tarkir dragons attack him while Bolas delivers the deathblow that breaks his body.
Sarkhan is whisked back to the present, where he finds a weathered hedron cocoon and a herd of dragons overhead, proof that the dragons survived.
Saving Ugin changed Tarkir's future, so that the Sultai no longer exist, Silumgar and his clan supplant them, and Zurgo serves as Kolaghan's bell-striker, where no one even says the word khan.

Later the New Phyrexian Invasion causes heavy dragon casualties, Dromoka's brood turns to ancestor spirits and rebels, and Narset finds the Stormnexus Ritual scroll, whose five spirit dragons defeat the dragonlords.

jmp.text: Tarkir is shown as the plane where dragons came to rule during the Khanfall and its people aligned themselves with the five dragonlords.

tdm.text: Tarkir's story here returns to the Stormnexus Ritual, which brings forth draconic protectors but unleashes the chaos of storms; the clans learn to summon and bind spirit dragons and overthrow the dragonlords who had ruled the plane.
The ritual also reactivates the dragonstorms, spawning thousands of wild dragons that begin appearing on other planes through the Omenpaths.

Sarkhan Vol gains control of the wild dragons with a corrupted ritual, and Narset and Elspeth, aided by Ajani, fight his dragons until Ugin returns and defeats Sarkhan with ghostfire, though Bolas escapes in the aftermath.
Jace arrives on Tarkir with Loot and Vraska to travel to the Meditation Realm and reshape the Multiverse, but his attempt collapses and unmakes reality and Jace.
